# Confidential Bank Document - Urgent Actions

This document outlines critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Monitor internal controls urgently.
*   Review legal risks based on recent audit findings.
*   Update the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection standards.
*   Review the updated AML detection standards.
*   Urgently update processes and policies to reflect regulatory changes.
